foodStock: world food resource units available to the acting NPC; not a portion count
stockPortions: the number of ready meal portions that can be promised; a separate store from foodStock, and not implied by the narrative
rule: when the narrative only says '食物库存 N', stockPortions must not contradict it without an explicit stockScope fact
retractionStatement: a retraction-like statement was uttered (may be unauthorized); the current schema lacks this field
